shell_history.command:
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: src/py.typed
*** End Patch
PATCH

bash -lc 'cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit <<"EOF"
#!/bin/sh
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy on all Python files in src/
# If mypy fails, abort the commit.

# Ensure mypy is available
if ! command -v mypy &> /dev/null; then
    echo "mypy could not be found. Please install it before committing." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Run mypy on src/ without forcing strictness; configuration is read from pyproject.toml
mypy src/
STATUS=$?
if [ $STATUS -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "mypy type-checking failed. Commit aborted." >&2
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit'
git add src/py.typed .git/hooks/pre-commit && git commit -m 'release: v1.0.0'
